events.text: CelcomDigi Berhad's Corporate Governance Report 2025 (STOCK CODE: 6947) is for the FINANCIAL YEAR December 31, 2025 and includes disclosures pursuant to Paragraph 15.25 of Bursa Malaysia Listing Requirements.
CelcomDigi Bhd's wholly-owned subsidiary CelcomDigi Mobile Sdn Bhd plans to defend claims filed by IMMA Technology Sdn Bhd over an alleged breach of a services agreement.
CelcomDigi Mobile Sdn Bhd will defend the RM72.6 million arbitration claim by IMMA Technology over an alleged breach of a services agreement signed in March 2022.

CelcomDigi Berhad's wholly-owned unit CelcomDigi Mobile Sdn Bhd received a notice of arbitration from IMMA Technology Sdn Bhd over alleged losses arising from a services agreement, and denies liability.
CelcomDigi Bhd paid RM139 million in employee termination costs involving 600 employees in the first quarter of 2024.
